items.name: VR Bengaluru Cube Open B 2025

venue.name: VR Bengaluru
venue.address: Whitefield Main Road, Devasandra Industrial Estate, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048

items.information:
Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website.**
​
* All participants must be present for the entire duration of the competition irrespective of the number of events.
​
* All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.
 
* Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue. 
​
* We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called.
​
* Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations.
​
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.
​
* Participants must bring their own cubes.

items.name: Flushing Glow Autumn PM 2025
items.information:
This is a series competition with Flushing Glow Autumn AM 2025.
You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions.
If you have already registered (with payment) for [Flushing Glow Autumn AM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlushingGlowAutumnAM2025) , your registration for this competition will be rejected.

This competition is sponsored by the Glow Cultural Center, which provides cultural, wellness, and youth development programs and serves as a hub for community activity. Glow aims to serve the multi-cultural population of the community, including but not limited to the under-served new immigrant, low-income households residing in Flushing and nearby communities. All proceeds from this competition will go to the Glow Cultural Center. Please see the Sponsor/Fundraiser tab for more details.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA1MjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--283a8a50314be1eaa950ad28e6ef3f561468fee8/glow.jpg)

items.name: ʻAiea Liʻi ʻOkakopa 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Oʻahu cubing returns with a mini competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.

##### We will also be holding Team Blind for the first time! Please check the [Team Blind tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AieaLiiOkakopa2025#63062-team-blind) for more information!
